text:
Liam: Heads-up NYC team: arriving at LGA, only 45 mins between meetings. Need a quick, decent halal spot near Flatiron. Any fast recs? :airplane:
Priya: Halal Guys on 6th is classic but often lines. Try 23rd & 6th, faster midday.
Carlos: DonerDeli on Broadway is 5 min walk and they do boxed platters that are quick.
Maya: Also check KatiRoll (E 22nd) they wrap tight and pretty portable.
SnackBot: Quick picks: DonerDeli (fast), KatiRoll (portable), HalalGuys (iconic). Filter: under 10 min walk.
Liam: Need to avoid long queues. Any that accept online preorders?
Carlos: DonerDeli accepts orders via their site. KatiRoll sometimes does via third-party apps. HalalGuys sometimes uses app for skip-the-line.
Priya: Pro tip: go for the platters at DonerDeli if you need to share or eat quickly. They plate it neatly.
Maya: If you want a veggie option, KatiRoll has paneer roll that's nicely sealed.
Liam: Thanks everyone, ordering DonerDeli pickup now. Will update if I get delayed. :thumbsup:
